# Igris Inertial

> A secure, governed AI execution runtime for agents, inference, and robotics. Igris provides bounded execution with verifiable traces, deterministic behavior, and local fallback — deployable as a 16MB binary on servers, edge devices, and ROS 2 systems. BYOM (bring your own model) with GGUF support and cloud API routing via Overture.

## Product

- [Runtime](https://igrisinertial.com/runtime/): A 16MB binary that executes AI models locally with bounded execution, sandboxed safety, and offline capability. Supports GGUF models and fleet management.
- [Overture](https://igrisinertial.com/ai-agents/): The cloud coordination layer for routing decisions across LLM providers. Shadow mode testing, cost tracking, and provider health monitoring.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/): Platform introduction — what Igris is, how it works, and who it's for.
- [Architecture](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/architecture/): System design — hybrid behavior trees, the three-layer model (Execution, Intelligence, Memory & Proof).
- [Quick Start](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/quickstart/): Get running in minutes. Install Runtime, configure providers, execute your first bounded task.
- [Execution Model](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/execution-model/): How bounded execution works — envelopes, resource limits, signed violation logs, and deterministic paths.
- [Safety & Containment](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/safety/): OS-level cgroup containment, sandboxed execution, hard limits on runtime, memory, and network access.
- [Capabilities & Limits](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/capability-model/): Fine-grained capability grants — HTTP, shell, filesystem, tool access, max tokens, max steps.
- [Execution Receipts](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/execution-receipts/): Cryptographically signed audit records for every decision and action. Query, export, and verify.
- [Agent Lifecycle](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/agent-lifecycle/): Agent states — init, running, idle, degraded, terminated. Transitions and failure handling.
- [Agents](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/agents/): Reflection, planning, swarm coordination, and tool-use patterns.
- [Behavior Trees](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/behavior-trees/): Deterministic execution paths using sequence, selector, condition, and action nodes. LLM invocation as a tool within structured trees.
- [Tools](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/tools/): HTTP, shell, filesystem, and configuration tools with security constraints.
- [Memory](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/memory/): Vector store, KV cache, cross-instance context, and MCP swarm memory.
- [Robotics](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/robotics/): Autonomous systems execution — ROS 2 integration, fleet coordination, safety limits for physical systems.
- [ROS 2 Integration](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/ros2-integration/): ROS 2 Humble and Iron support — topics, services, behavior trees for robotic systems.
- [Cloud Coordination](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/cloud-coordination/): Provider routing, failover, cost optimization, and health monitoring across LLM providers.
- [Fleet Management](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/fleet-management/): Device registration, OTA updates, config push, health monitoring, and fleet-wide operations.
- [Policy](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/policy/): Routing strategy, budget limits, provider selection, and fallback configuration.
- [Audit](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/audit/): Compliance, receipt export, execution lineage, and verifiable traces.
- [SDK](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/sdk/): Client libraries for JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
- [Deployment](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/deployment/): Cloud, edge, and self-hosted deployment — Fly.io, Kubernetes, bare metal.
- [API Reference](https://docs.igrisinertial.com/docs/api-reference/): REST API endpoints for inference, management, receipts, fleet, and policy.

- [Pricing](https://igrisinertial.com/pricing/): Free, Pro, and Enterprise tiers.
